API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APITime IntervalsTime Interval Resource Get Time Interval By ID
Time Interval Resource Get Time Interval By ID
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/timeIntervals/:Id

Retrieves the configured time interval based on the specified ID

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
Id
int32
REQUIRED

Unique identifier for the time interval

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

System-generated identifier for the time interval

name
string

Name to identify the time interval

startTime
int32

The time interval start time

endTime
int32

The time interval end time

daysOfWeek
string[]

Specifies which days of the week apply to the time interval. If set to EVERYDAY, all the days of the week are chosen.

Possible values: [ANY, NONE, EVERYDAY, SUN, MON, TUE, WED, THU, FRI, SAT]
